title: Beehive Acoustic Activity Pattern
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beehive:reading
| timechart span=1h avg(sound_db) as buzz
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
description: Trends the hum of the hive through the day, a window into foraging activity and the colony's changing mood.
value: Hive sound reflects activity and stress; watching its daily rhythm adds a non-invasive dimension no scale or thermometer captures.
implementation: Ingest a hive microphone level into `index=personal`; review the daily buzz pattern.
visualization: Line chart of hive sound level over the day.
grandmaExplanation: It listens to how loudly the hive is buzzing through the day, which hints at how busy and happy the bees are.
